_A_SELECT_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ASelect is a component that allows users to make one or more choices from a predefined list of options.
_A_SELECT_EXCLUSIVE_OPTION_DESCRIPTION_: An exclusive option can be defines as a special choice that, when selected, prevents the selection of any other options or deselects all previously chosen options.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_GROUPS_DESCRIPTION_: Select options in a dropdown can be customized by grouping them by one or multiple keys. This can be useful for cases where one choice overrides all others, like a "None of the above" or "Select All" option.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_KEY_DISABLED_DESCRIPTION: Select option values in a dropdown can be disabled based on the object key for each option.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_RETRIEVE_DESCRIPTION_: Loads the base list and retrieve candidates from local JSON files without a backend. Missing selected values are fetched through the retrieve callback and marked as invalid entries when they are not present in the base list.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_SEARCH_DESCRIPTION_: Select options values can be filtered based on the search query. This is useful for components with a long list of options, makeing it easier for users for find and choose the needed option. A screen reader hears how many options the search found ("Results: 3" / "No results"); Enter in the search field does not submit the form around.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_SHOW_SELECTED_FIRST_DESC: With show-selected-first, selected options are displayed directly below the search and action buttons. They keep their groups when grouping is enabled, are separated from the remaining options by one divider, and are not duplicated in the main list.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_SHOW_SELECTED_FIRST_DESC: Displays selected options before the remaining options and removes their duplicates from the main list. Grouping is preserved.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_TRANSLATE_DATA_DESCRIPTI: Translations of labels are supported for dropdown options. Search is also supported with localized, translated options.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_BUTTON_CLASS_DESCRIPTION: Additional CSS class of the button that opens the list.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_BUTTON_CLASS_DEFAULT_DES: Default CSS classes of the button that opens the list. Replace them to change the look completely.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_CARET_ICON_DESCRIPTION_: Icon next to the button that opens the list. The default is a downward arrow.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION_: CSS class or class object of the outer container of the component.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_COUNT_MULTISELECT_DESCRI: Multiselect: how many selected items are shown in the button. The others are summarized as "+N more".
_A_SELECT_PROPS_DESELECTABLE_DESCRIPTION: Select: the selected item can be deselected by clicking it again.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_EXCEEDED_ITEMS_DELETABLE: Multiselect: shows a button that removes the selected items beyond count-multiselect.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_HAS_CARET_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the icon next to the button that opens the list.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_IN_BODY_DESCRIPTION_: The list is rendered in the container popper-container-id at the end of the body, otherwise directly after the button.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_IS_CLOSE_BY_CLICK_DESCRI: Closes the list after an item is chosen. By default: yes for select, no for multiselect.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_IS_SELECTION_CLOSEABLE_D: Multiselect: all selected items are shown in the button. If false, only the count is shown when there are more than count-multiselect. The values are next to the field (not in it), their remove buttons can be reached with Tab.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: Label of the field (text or translation key).
_A_SELECT_PROPS_LABEL_CLASS_DESCRIPTION_: Additional CSS class of the label.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_LABEL_SCREENREADER_DESCR: Label that is read only by screen readers.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_MAX_COUNT_MULTISELECT_DE: Multiselect: maximum number of items that can be selected.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_MENU_CLASS_DESCRIPTION_: Additional CSS class of the list.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_MENU_WIDTH_TYPE_DESCRIPT: Width of the list: "as_button" (as wide as the button) or "by_content" (as wide as its content).
_A_SELECT_PROPS_PLACEHOLDER_DESCRIPTION_: Text in the button when nothing is selected.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_PLACEMENT_DESCRIPTION_: Position of the list relative to the button.
_A_SELECT_PROPS_POPPER_CONTAINER_ID_DESC: ID of the container at the end of the body in which the list is rendered (with in-body).
_A_SELECT_PROPS_SELECT_MENU_CLASS_DESCRI: Additional CSS class of the list.
_A_SELECT_EVENTS_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: Emitted when the list is opened.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_MODE_ONE_PER_GROUP_DESCR: With mode="one_per_group" and key-group a multiselect allows only one item of each group: choosing an item deselects the other item of its group.
_A_SELECT_GROUP_LABEL_NOT_FOUND_DESCRIPT: If the model contains a value that is not in data, the text label-not-found is shown instead (with show-not-found).
_A_SELECT_A11Y_DESCRIPTION_: The field is a role="combobox" with aria-controls to the role="listbox"; in the listbox are only the options (and groups), the search and "Select all" are above it. Keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown open the list, the arrows go round, Home and End go to the first and last option, a letter to the next option that starts with it, Escape closes and gives the focus back to the field. The search tells a screen reader how many options it found. With type="multiselect" the list has aria-multiselectable="true".
_A_SELECT_GROUP_MULTISELECT_CLOSEABLE_DE: The selected values are buttons next to the field: they can be reached with Tab, and their name says which value is removed ("Remove Berlin"). The field itself tells a screen reader how many values are selected.
